openTomorrow: Yeah, definitely! I want to join my friend's challenge - that's literally why I downloaded this. Plus the 'Show Up 7' program seems doable, just committing to showing up for 7 days.
secured: I think it means your data and personal info is protected and safe on the app, like your fitness data won't be shared without permission.
freeze: I'm guessing it's like pausing your commitment temporarily? Like if you're sick or traveling and can't do your challenge for a bit, you freeze it instead of breaking your streak.
selfReported: That means we're inputting our own data manually instead of syncing with like a fitness tracker or watch. Basically you tell the app what you did, they trust you.
best: Seeing that my friend Yaseen has a 6-day streak already! That made me feel motivated - like okay, they're actually doing this and I want to join them and build that momentum together.
worst: Honestly, the interface felt a bit confusing at first? I had to figure out where everything was and what the different tabs meant. It took me a minute to understand what I was even looking at.
tellFriend: For sure! I'd be like 'Hey, this app is actually cool for accountability - it shows your streak and you can see your friends doing challenges too. Way better than just saying we'll work out together.' I'd definitely invite them to join my challenge.
